user.title: Mower
user.description: Pick the Mammotion mower. Luba Scheduler finds its activity, battery, RTK, camera and zone entities from the device, so later renames in the Mammotion integration don't break it.

zones.title: Zone groups
zones.description: Split the mower's zones into two groups. Each mow day cuts one group, and the groups never share a day.

inputs.title: Conditions
inputs.description: The sensors that decide whether it is a good time to mow (permission) and whether a running mow must stop (danger). Optional inputs that are left empty simply never trip.

data_description.mow_allowed_a_entity: Optional. While this is not on, Group A is treated as held for overseeding. Unavailable counts as held.
data_description.mow_allowed_b_entity: Optional. While this is not on, Group B is treated as held for overseeding. Unavailable counts as held.

gate.title: Gate
gate.description: The mower is never started while the gate is open. An unavailable gate sensor always counts as open.

error.missing_roles: This device is missing entities Luba Scheduler needs: {missing}. Is it a Mammotion mower, and is the integration loaded?
error.no_zones: This mower has no zone switches yet. Create zones in the Mammotion app first.
error.empty_group: Each group needs at least one zone.
error.overlapping_groups: A zone can belong to only one group.

mower.title: Mower
mower.description: Pick the Mammotion mower. Changing to a different mower clears the zone groups.

inputs.description: Clear an optional field to stop using it.

gate.title: Gate

data.cutoff_before_sunset_minutes: No new mow within this long of sunset
data.canopy_max_f: Hottest canopy temperature (above this, a running mow stops)
data.precip_chance_max: Start only while precipitation chance is below
data.lightning_radius: Lightning radius (in the distance sensor's unit)
data.lightning_recency_minutes: A strike counts for this long
data.fresh_start_battery_floor: Battery needed for a fresh start
data.optimal_delay_minutes: Conditions must hold this long before they count
data.angle_options: Mowing angles to rotate through (degrees, comma-separated)
data.spacing_options: Path spacings to rotate through (cm, comma-separated)

timing.title: Timing
timing.description: When the day's schedule runs, and how long Luba Scheduler waits for the mower at each step.

data.start_verify_seconds: Wait for the mower to start, per attempt
data.route_verify_seconds: Wait for the planned route after a fresh start
data.reprompt_interval_minutes: Re-prompt interval (also the Delay button's length)
data.cancel_timeout_seconds: Wait for a cancelled job to clear
data.resume_battery_floor: Battery needed to resume a held job
data.offline_timeout_minutes: Mower unavailable this long counts as offline
data.idle_reconcile_minutes: Mower ready this long mid-session counts as finished

mode.title: Mode
mode.description:
**Shadow** (the default) runs the whole schedule and logs every decision, but never commands the mower, never sends a notification and never writes the calendar.

**Active** commands the mower. Only one system may command the mower: turn off every YAML Luba automation first, then tick the confirmation. Luba Scheduler refuses active mode while any `automation.luba_*` is on.

data.confirm_active: I have turned off the YAML automations; let Luba Scheduler command the mower

data_description.yaml_state_entity: Optional. The YAML package's FSM entity. While set, the State sensor shows yaml_state and diverged, and a divergence that lasts 5 minutes is written to the logbook, with another line when it clears.

error.missing_roles: This device is missing entities Luba Scheduler needs: {missing}.
error.no_zones: This mower has no zone switches yet.
error.empty_group: Each group needs at least one zone.
error.overlapping_groups: A zone can belong to only one group.
error.canopy_range: The hottest temperature must be above the coolest.
error.bad_list: Enter distinct whole numbers separated by commas, within the allowed range.
error.resume_above_start: The resume floor can't be above the fresh-start floor (Thresholds and settings).
error.confirm_active: Tick the confirmation to switch to active mode.
error.yaml_still_active: {count} YAML Luba automations are still on. Turn them off first.

options.on_closed: On means the gate is closed
options.on_open: On means the gate is open (door/contact sensors)

options.shadow: Shadow: decide and log, command nothing

dead_bindings.title: Mower entities are missing
dead_bindings.description: These can no longer be found: {names}. A zone the mower rebuilt (for example after merging or renaming zones in the Mammotion app) is a new zone. Re-pick it under Luba Scheduler → Configure → Zone groups (or Mower).

start_mow_drift.title: Mammotion changed its start command
start_mow_drift.description: mammotion.start_mow's fields changed. Added: {added}. Removed: {removed}. A new field gets a default Luba Scheduler never chose, so review it before the next mow and update Luba Scheduler.

start_mow_unreadable.title: Can't read Mammotion's start command
start_mow_unreadable.description: Luba Scheduler could not read the fields of mammotion.start_mow, so it cannot tell whether a Mammotion update changed them.

entity_id_taken.title: A Luba Scheduler entity got a different id
entity_id_taken.description: {expected} was already taken, so Home Assistant created {actual} instead. Remove or rename the old entity that holds {expected}, then reload Luba Scheduler.

queue_overflow.title: Luba Scheduler dropped an event
queue_overflow.description: The intent queue was full, so `{intent}` was dropped. This should never happen; the log has the details. Check the mower's state before the next mow, then reload Luba Scheduler to clear this.

yaml_still_active.title: YAML Luba automations are still on
yaml_still_active.description: Luba Scheduler is in active mode, but {count} `automation.luba_*` automations are still on. Only one system may command the mower, so every mower command is refused. Turn the YAML automations off, or switch Luba Scheduler back to shadow mode.

import_yaml_state.name: Import YAML state
import_yaml_state.description: Copy the YAML package's state (FSM, session, day, counters, settings) into Luba Scheduler, for the cutover. Pass values, typically templates reading the YAML helpers; only the fields given are written, so it can be run again. Refused unless the mode is shadow.

fsm_state.name: FSM state
fsm_state.description: The YAML FSM state. Charging is imported as Paused.

error_from.name: Error from
error_from.description: The state the Error came from.

session_start.name: Session start
session_start.description: Local date and time; 1970-01-01 or empty means no session.

session_work_area.name: Session work area
session_work_area.description: The work area captured at the session start.

session_abort_reason.name: Abort reason
session_abort_reason.description: Non-empty while a weather-aborted session is held.

evaluated_at.name: Evaluated at
evaluated_at.description: When the day was last scheduled (local date and time).

auto_start.name: Auto-start
auto_start.description: Whether a ready prompt starts the mow by itself.

import_needs_shadow.message: Import is only allowed in shadow mode: it would overwrite the state of a system that is commanding the mower. Switch to shadow mode first.
